title: Explorative Modeling: Unlocking a Third Pretraining Axis and End-to-End Generation
author: explorative-modeling.github.io
summary: Explorative Modeling adds a new way to train generative models by exploring multiple outputs and choosing the best. This approach improves efficiency and quality across images, video, and language, especially as models and data scale up. It also enables end-to-end generation, matching strong methods with much less computation.
